outlook: Wheat bounced Thursday after reports that China's COFCO inquired about U.S. soft red winter wheat for shipment after the New Year: Minneapolis December spring wheat rose 4¾ cents to $6.24½ and Chicago December wheat gained 4¾ cents to $6.03¾. December corn slipped ½ cent to $4.51¼, finishing mid-range after touching a 3½-month low early in the session. November soybeans fell 4¾ cents to $12.19¾ on technical selling, with soybean meal hitting a two-month low, and ICE November canola eased C$2.10 to C$771.70. Cash bids shown are still from Tuesday's USDA Minneapolis report, the latest available.

news.title: After the Bell | Wheat bounces on strong export sales
